title: Retro Eighties Mall Portrait
content: A 1980s studio portrait of a smiling Black man with an afro and beard. He wears a teal, magenta, and blue retro nylon windbreaker, a white graphic tee, and a gold chain. Medium close-up composition. Background features a classic 80s laser backdrop with neon pink and blue lines, a blurred palm tree, and a retro boombox. Captured with vintage film camera style, soft studio lighting, subtle grain, and a warm, nostalgic color palette.
